region, How does Heidi work for nurses?

Heidi is an AI care partner built for how nurses actually work. Scribe listens across your shift and turns spoken observations into structured progress notes, SBAR handovers, and care plans. Evidence gives you cited clinical answers at the bedside. This reduces the documentation load so you stay with your patients.
